name: Terraced townhouse pair
description: Pair of narrow three-storey terraced town houses, 11.2 x 9.2 m together: one rendered, one brick, with stone quoins and string courses, shuttered windows and a slate roof split by a party-wall upstand carrying the shared chimney stack. Each house has its own front door, a room on every floor and its own stair; the rear corridors are knocked through the party wall on every floor.

steps.note: core A: level 0 up to the half landing
core A: level 1 up to the half landing
core B: level 2 down to the half landing
